description: Whole-log receipt validation cases: validate(receipt bytes) yields the expected status, reason, and hashes.

cases.name: clean-full-log
cases.description: A scripted log exercising request, capability, action, result, summary, and response.

cases.name: tainted-retraction
cases.description: Retracting a Summary's Use source taints the dependent Summary; the log still verifies.

cases.name: invalid-forged-verdict
cases.description: A stored Verdict is changed to Reject; replay re-derives Accept and the mismatch is caught.

cases.name: invalid-tampered-id
cases.description: The genesis record id is corrupted; the recomputed id no longer matches.

cases.name: invalid-missing-verdict
cases.description: A Verdict record is removed; a non-verdict record is no longer immediately judged.

cases.name: tainted-use-not-cause
cases.description: Retracting a record taints its Use dependent (a Summary) but not its Cause dependent (a Plan). The tainted set is the ground truth for non-propagation through Cause.

cases.name: tainted-require-leg
cases.description: Retracting a capability taints the Action whose only edge to it is a Require ref, and transitively the Summary that Used the action; the Cause-only Result stays untainted. The tainted set is the ground truth for propagation through Require.

cases.name: tainted-require-target-rejected
cases.description: An Action Requiring an already-tainted capability is rejected at commit position with RefUnresolved; the rejected record stays in the log with its Reject verdict and replay agrees.
